tracks.title: We don’t blend
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro — whispered, no drums]
Yeah…
They said, “Fit in.”
We broke the frame.
Black thread. Cold nerve.
Remember the name.

[Low distorted whisper]
Dawn Sogni…
You weren’t made to blend.

[Silence]

[Shout]
WELCOME TO THE OTHER SIDE!

[Ad-libs]
Wake up… wake up…

[Verse 1 — dark trap beat]
Came up with the night pressed into my coat,
Made my own path when they handed me a rope.
Everybody wears a face for the room,
I kept mine sharp; let the whole thing bloom.

No hand-me-down throne, no borrowed crown,
Built from the seams they tried to tear down.
They print the same shape, send it down the line,
We cut our own pattern; the choice is mine.

Black on black, let the outline speak,
Storm in my ribs, got a world underneath.
Chase every trend, still lose your feet;
I’d rather stand apart than repeat what they teach.

No permission slip, no leash, no code,
We make our own mark where the borders fold.
Say the name when the room goes dim:
DAWN SOGNI — we don’t blend in.

[Ad-libs]
No copies! Stand alone! Yeah!

[Hook — gang shouts, heavy bass]
WE DON’T FIT — WE CUT OUR OWN!
BLACKED-OUT HEARTS — THIS IS HOME!

[Beat drops to silence]

DAWN SOGNI! — WE DON’T BOW!
BUILT DIFFERENT — SAY IT LOUD!
No rules, no chains, no fitting in,
We were born where the light grows thin.
No borrowed face, no need to pretend,
DAWN SOGNI — WE DON’T BLEND!

[Ad-libs]
Don’t blend! Don’t blend!

[Beat Switch 1 — eerie half-time, distorted whisper]
You see a label…
We make a statement.
You call it a trend…
WE’RE NOT THE SAME THING.

[Metallic impact]
Who said we had to be like them?

[Silence]

[Shout]
WHO?!

[Beat Switch 2 — faster drums, hard drop]

[Verse 2 — aggressive rapid flow]
Keep your plastic praise, keep your polished applause,
We were sewing in the dark while you waited for a cause.
Every stitch holds weight, every cut leaves a scar,
We don’t dress for the room; we decide who we are.

No feed can forecast us, no mold can contain us,
If the world says “change,” tell the world it can’t name us.
We move with intent, put the doubt on the floor,
When they shut one door, we make ten more.

[Gang shouts]
Make ten more! Make ten more!

[Final Hook — biggest gang vocals]
WE DON’T FIT — WE CUT OUR OWN!
BLACKED-OUT HEARTS — THIS IS HOME!
DAWN SOGNI! — WE DON’T BOW!
BUILT DIFFERENT — SAY IT LOUD!
No rules, no chains, no fitting in,
We were born where the light grows thin.
No borrowed face, no need to pretend,
DAWN SOGNI — WE DON’T BLEND!

[Outro — dark whispered, beat fades]
DAWN SOGNI…
Born in the dark…
Never blend in.

tracks.title: One Picture Away
tracks.lyrics:
ONE PICTURE AWAY

Original Emotional Pop-Rap Duet | English + Hinglish

[INTRO – Male | Soft Piano]

Funny how life has its own little ways,
You spend your time running from yesterday.
I wasn’t searching, wasn’t waiting for a sign,
Then one little picture crossed a thousand miles.

[VERSE 1 – Male]

I’ve seen the faces, heard the names,
Had conversations that all felt the same.
A hundred hellos, a thousand goodbyes,
Never found a reason to give it a try.

They said there’s someone, just give it a chance,
But I never believed in a picture romance.
Then you appeared on a regular day,
And something inside me just wanted to stay.

[VERSE 2 – Female]

I had my reasons, I had my doubts,
Kept turning the possibilities down.
Every new story felt déjà vu,
Until that one day I came across you.

I didn’t know you, didn’t know your name,
Didn’t know if you’d ever feel the same.
But there was something I couldn’t explain,
A little curiosity I couldn’t contain.

[PRE-CHORUS – Both]

Male: Was it the smile? Was it the eyes?
Female: Was it the feeling I couldn’t describe?
Male: We hadn’t spoken, hadn’t met.
Female: But somehow I couldn’t forget.

Both: Maybe all the roads we took
Were leading to this moment yet.

[CHORUS – Both | Emotional]

We were just one picture away,
One little hello from a brand new day.
All of those hearts we couldn’t choose,
Led us to something we couldn’t refuse.

And I don’t know what tomorrow will bring,
Or what this little beginning will mean.
But if I have a reason to believe in fate,
It’s that one picture that I couldn’t replace.

[RAP VERSE – Male | Beat Drop]

Yeah…

Too many names, too many frames,
Different faces but the feeling’s the same.
Everybody asking, “When’s it your turn?”
Funny how the heart takes time to learn.

No fairytale, no cinematic scene,
Just a little photo on a mobile screen.
One said yes, one said maybe,
Two independent souls acting kinda crazy.

Then came the day, yeah, the first hello,
Didn’t know which way the conversation would go.
Forty-five minutes, but it felt like five,
Didn’t wanna leave, didn’t wanna say goodbye.

No perfect lines, no rehearsed reply,
Just a little nervousness we couldn’t hide.
And maybe that’s the beauty, maybe that’s the clue,
Out of everyone, I got to meet you.

I turned down a thousand, never knew why,
Maybe I was waiting for the right pair of eyes.

[HINDI SECTION – Female | Soft Melody]

Kuch toh tha teri tasveer mein,
Jo ruk gayi nazar meri uss bheed mein.
Na jaana tujhe, na pehchaana tha,
Phir bhi kuch apna sa laga tha.

Na koi vaada, na koi kasam,
Bas dheere dheere badhne laga yeh kadam.
Kal ki fikar abhi karte nahi,
Par tere bina yeh sochte nahi.

[BRIDGE – Male & Female | Piano Only]

Male: I don’t need to know the ending,
I just wanna see this through.

Female: I don’t need a perfect story,
I just wanna write it with you.

Male: And if we’re scared, we’ll take it slowly.

Female: If we fall, we’ll learn to fly.

Both: We were strangers not so long ago,
Now you’re the reason I don’t wanna say goodbye.

[FINAL CHORUS – Both | Full Production]

We were just one picture away,
One little hello from a lifetime someday.
All of those no’s, all of those nights,
Somehow brought our worlds into line.

And I don’t know what forever will be,
But there’s something beautiful waiting to see.
Out of all the faces, all the roads we knew,
I said no to the world,
But I said yes to you.

[OUTRO – Soft Duet]

Female: Just one picture…

Male: Just one meeting…

Female: And a thousand things to discover…

Both: Maybe this is where forever begins
